accepted_claim: specific rule-qualified raw-GNSS anchor retained across isolation supports motion-verified SPP position admission in a fixed-rotation LIO position backend, within declared uncertainty and data limits

nearest_work.WinTA_GIL: window alignment and heading refinement; here no yaw estimation or heading pseudomeasurement
nearest_work.Dual_ACKF: bias-augmented INS/GNSS and adaptive CKF; here unchanged 3D position KF and raw observation admission only

evidence_limits: two same-route caches are numerical sensitivity, not two independent routes
primary gain mainly persistent post-outage bias; some other categories worsen
without R decay is slightly better, decay contribution is not supported
original anchor can be biased and local drift observationally equivalent to GNSS bias
MM/INS reference shares AT128; controlled initial truth epoch; unknown geographic origin
publication: application evidence only; no readiness or acceptance claim
